notes.claim_list: Scope begins with the deposited face-model dependent-variable data.
notes.sol: The source assessed Studies 1 and 3, not all four studies. Scope starts from the supplied face-model dependent variable. Changes to composites, difference scores and outlier exclusions are robustness checks and are excluded.
notes.claude: Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes.claude_blind_original_historical: Could not access the paper: download attempt returned a different article (PLOS ONE 'Implicit race attitudes modulate visual information extraction for trustworthiness') under this DOI, so it was discarded. C1-C3 reported values match the report's quotes. Report also notes 4 extra outlier exclusions in the main analyses not stated in text/prereg (robustness-related, not scored). C4/C5 coefficients are never printed in the report, so 'match' rests on its general statement; a reconciler might prefer not_checkable if requiring a value. Report focused on Studies 1 and 3 only; face-model construction not reproduced (out of scope per claims-file note).
